title: Quiet Tap: low-noise traffic tap with budgeted sampling and tenant quarantine
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a low-overhead "quiet tap" pipeline that duplicates a configurable fraction of production requests into a shadow execution path. Goals: (1) Observe model behavior under production traffic with minimal cost and latency impact, (2) Ensure tenant-level cost isolation and automatic quarantine when shadow budget is exceeded, (3) Provide deterministic sampling controls and safe failover when the shadow pipeline is degraded.
design_decisions: - Use probabilistic per-request sampling driven by tenant credit buckets instead of uniform sampling to prevent noisy cost spikes. - Shadow requests are sent to a lightweight proxy that strips side-effecting headers and enforces idempotency guards. - The tap must add <1ms p95 latency; we will implement async duplication via the edge process and nonblocking buffer. - On overload, the pipeline gracefully sheds shadow load starting from anonymous/low-priority tenants. - Quarantine mode isolates tenants exceeding budget, emits alerts, and optionally mutes further shadowing until manual review.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag gated rollout to internal tenants, 2) Canary at 5% traffic with strict cost fencing, 3) Expand to pilot customers with per-tenant budgets, 4) Enable auto-quarantine and observe for 2 weeks before wider enablement.
test_plan: - Unit tests for credit accounting and sampling arithmetic. - Integration test harness with synthetic traffic and budget exhaustion scenarios. - Chaos test: simulate downstream shadow worker failures and validate fail-open/fail-closed behavior. - A/B compare shadow outputs vs baseline on a held-out set for divergence metrics.
monitoring: - Dashboards: per-tenant shadow spend, sampling rate, queue depth, duplicate-success-rate. - Alerts: tenant_quarantine_triggered, shadow_queue_backpressure, proxy_error_rate>1%. - Traces: end-to-end path for duplicated requests including timestamps at edge, proxy, shadow worker.
reviews: PM UX review by Linh Tran: OK with UI showing per-tenant quarantines.
Security review note: KMS integration for tenant budgets is required.
SRE: ensure replay queue has durable retention and backpressure signals.
comments: 2026-01-18 - Initial spike: verified async duplication via edge is feasible; copied payload size is dominant cost — added compression step.
2026-01-22 - Implemented tenant credit bucket prototype; observed deterministic drift under bursty traffic; switching to sliding-window replenishment.
2026-01-28 - SRE requested a hard limit on in-flight duplicated requests per host; added a token-bucket per host in the proxy.
2026-02-02 - QA found a race when toggling feature flag mid-request; added atomic toggle check at duplication decision point.
2026-02-03 - Ready for internal canary; feature flag and per-tenant budget UI wired in console dashboard (PR linked).
notes: Trade-offs: aggressive compression reduces cost but can change timing for certain models. We prefer keeping original payload for a small subset of tenants flagged by PM for fidelity checks.
